NUCA without E.message: ⛔ NUCA=1 needs E in NUPARTS: the exact adiabatic sound speed IS a term of the Euler equation, and here NUPARTS='WC'

a bad letter.message: ⛔ NUPARTS='WX': the letters are W (the weight), C (continuity) and E (Euler), and at least one is needed

an empty set.message: ⛔ NUPARTS='': the letters are W (the weight), C (continuity) and E (Euler), and at least one is needed

no NUFD.message: ⛔ NUPERT=1 needs NUFD=1 and MNU != 0: the repair IS the species' own Fermi-Dirac weight, and here NUFD=0 MNU=0.3

zero sum.message: ⛔ NUPERT=1 needs NUFD=1 and MNU != 0: the repair IS the species' own Fermi-Dirac weight, and here NUFD=0 MNU=0.0
